_comment: Dealership Accelerator is GoHighLevel, white-labelled by Envoke Digital. Captured from the live UI on 2026-09-16. NO CREDENTIALS IN THIS FILE - the signed-in session lives in a browser profile outside the repo.
_the_better_path: Because DA is GoHighLevel, the LeadConnector REST API would do all of this with
no browser at all - far more reliable than driving the UI. It is blocked only
because Envoke Digital has not enabled Private Integrations on this sub-account:
Settings shows no 'Private Integrations' and no 'API Keys' entry.
Ask Envoke to enable Private Integrations for location TfYNq7UU87ZNWFKsZNRn with
the scopes social-media-posting.write and medias.write, then switch
publishing.platform to 'gohighlevel' and this whole file stops mattering.
_comment_armed: Selectors were captured from the live UI, but posting has NEVER been exercised end to end - doing that means publishing a real ad. While armed is false the adapter refuses to click Post and tells you what to do instead. Set it to true only after one supervised test post has gone through.

session._comment: Holds live session cookies. Kept outside the repo on purpose. Blank uses ~/.ims-ads/da-profile.

selectors._comment: The sp-cmp-* ids are GoHighLevel component ids and are stabler than class names. ORDER MATTERS - see _sequence below.
selectors._image_input_note: WRONG BEFORE: #image_uploads looked right but belongs to #social-planner-feedback-drawer (the support widget), not the composer. Uploading there would have attached the ad to a feedback form and posted a caption with no image. The real input only EXISTS after clicking the image icon in the editor toolbar, which opens the Media Storage modal.
selectors.image_toolbar_button: 4th icon in the editor toolbar under #quill-editor (B, I, emoji, IMAGE, file, video, #, tag)
selectors.media_select_mode: tick each tile's CHECKBOX (top-left); clicking the tile body REPLACES the selection instead of adding

_sequence: 1. Load urls.post_composer.
2. Click account_picker, then tick the target account's checkbox. VERIFY which
account is selected afterwards by reading the '<Platform> options' block or the
Post Preview tab - several rows share the name 'International Motorsports
Motorcycle Company', and an accessibility-tree ref can resolve to a DIFFERENT
account on a later page load. This bit us: two of three drafts were created
against LinkedIn while targeting Instagram.
3. The caption editor is Quill and ships DISABLED (ql-disabled), as does Post -
both unlock only once an account is selected.
4. Caption: dispatch a real paste ClipboardEvent. Quill's instance is NOT exposed
(no __quill), so the API is unavailable, and innerText writes are ignored.

Separate paragraphs with a SINGLE 
 - Quill makes each line its own paragraph

and already renders a blank line, so 

 produces five newlines.
To replace existing text, clear with real ctrl+a then Delete keystrokes;
execCommand('selectAll') does not clear it and the paste appends instead.
5. Images: click the toolbar image icon -> Media Storage modal -> Upload tab ->
#file-upload-input -> tick checkboxes -> 'Insert Files'.
Insert order follows the library (newest first), NOT the tick order.
6. 'Save for later' (#sp-cmp-post-action-btn-save-draft) creates a Draft.
GBP posts need a required 'Type' field; posting to Instagram only avoids it.
A watermark notice appears: GHL applies the location watermark to ALL images on
publish, though the composer preview shows it on the first image only.

accounts._comment: Claude/Codex is a GROUP (listed under the GROUPS heading in the picker, above ALL ACCOUNTS). Selecting the group selects every account inside it, so this stays correct when an account is added or removed there - which is exactly why a group beats listing accounts individually.

_channel_limits._comment: Character limits shown in the composer. description.max_chars in config.json is 1200, which is inside every one of these.

_google_business_profile_options: GBP posts have a REQUIRED 'Type' field (seen set to 'Call to Action') plus an
optional 'Select button label'. Because two Google Business Profiles are in the
Claude/Codex group, every post through this group will hit that requirement.
This has NOT been automated - the dropdown options were never opened, and
guessing at them would mean submitting a post with a field set wrongly.
Capture them on the first supervised post, then add them here.
